title: fix(plugin-detail): a long text formula on the record page wraps instead of being cut to one line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GdE1SLkr1wiMoUgUDSPhRr)_

Fixes #34148

Clause-②: no — a value that was cut now shows in full; no surface added
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录详情页字段区里的公式字段，改用公式自己的只读显示（与记录表单同一张脸），长文本公式结果整句换行显示，不再截成一行加省略号。
- 为什么改：下游 CRM 的「预审说明」公式（约 120 字）在详情页只露出前几个字，完整内容只在鼠标悬停提示里，触屏和读屏用户看不到。
- 风险与回滚：只动详情页公式这一行的渲染选择；列表网格与顶部亮点条仍截断；数字、金额、日期、布尔结果文字不变。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` 新增的 `FormulaCellRenderer` 分支；测试 `record-details.textReadWraps-25897.test.tsx` 末尾两个 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.textReadWraps-25897.test.tsx`，预期 16 个全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On the record detail field grid, a `formula` value now reads through `FormulaField`'s read-only display, the face the record form already draws, instead of the formula cell. The formula cell's text face is `TextCellRenderer`, the grid's one-line cell (`truncate`, an ellipsis, the whole value only in a hover `title`), so a long text formula was cut to its first words.

This is the third branch of the same move `DetailSection` already makes for `textarea` (`TextAreaField`, objectui#11577) and for every type the table maps to `TextCellRenderer` (`TextField`, objectstack#25897):

- It is matched by renderer identity (`CellRenderer === FormulaCellRenderer`) and the `formula` type. A host that registered its own `formula` face keeps it.
- `FormulaField` reads the value by the same rule as the cell (declared `returnType`, else a JS number is a number and everything else is text). The fields package's `formulaFaces.*` tests compare the two faces' text for every return type. So number, money, date and boolean results read the same words as before. Only a text result changes how it lays out: it wraps.
- No hand-written `whitespace-pre-wrap` copy is added. The widget owns its read display.
- List grid rows and the highlights strip keep the one-line cell.

`summary` (roll-up) also maps to `FormulaCellRenderer` and is deliberately left on the cell. See Acceptance notes.

Premise, measured on `main` at 0d1443d0 (a 120-character value, DetailSection rendered in happy-dom):

| field | `resolveCellRendererType` | cell renderer | on main |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `text` | `text` | `TextCellRenderer` → `TextField` read display | wraps (objectstack#25897) |
| `textarea` | `textarea` | `TextAreaField` read display | wraps (objectui#11577) |
| `formula`, `returnType: 'text'` | `formula` | `FormulaCellRenderer` → text face `TextCellRenderer` | **truncated** (`span.block.max-w-full.truncate`, value in `title`) |
| `formula`, no `returnType`, string value | `formula` | same | **truncated** |
| `summary`, string value | `summary` | same | **truncated** (left as is, see notes) |

Card ask 2 (a long-text return type for formulas, a spec change) is not needed for the card's acceptance after this change: a text formula now wraps at any width without any new declaration.

## Tests

New top-level describes in the existing `record:details` read-wrap harness, `record-details.textReadWraps-25897.test.tsx` (no new file; `renderBody` takes an optional schema and field list):

- At 1440 px and at phone width (375 px): a 120-character `returnType: 'text'` formula and an undeclared formula holding the same string each render exactly the markup `FormulaField` renders read-only. The drawn node's text is the whole value, it has no `title`, and no element between it and the row carries `truncate` / `whitespace-nowrap` / `text-ellipsis` / `line-clamp-1`.
- CONTROL: the grid keeps the one-line formula cell (`getCellRenderer('formula')` is `FormulaCellRenderer`, which still draws `truncate` with the whole value as its `title`).
- CONTROL: a `returnType: 'number'` formula still reads `1,234.50` on the record page.
- CONTROL: a host's own `formula` face is kept on the record page.

The change is a renderer choice and a class list, so the viewport-sized jsdom/happy-dom render covers both widths named by the card's acceptance: no layout engine runs, and none is needed to read which element draws the value. A real-browser check was NOT MEASURED (no console stack started in this container). The drawn element is `span.text-sm`, the same element `TextField`'s read display draws for a wrapping `text` value since objectstack#25897.

No existing test was edited apart from adding the parameters to `renderBody`. Its existing callers pass nothing and behave as before.

<details><summary>Ablation (one leg, then restored)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `DetailSection.tsx`: the anchor `if (CellRenderer === FormulaCellRenderer && resolvedType === 'formula')` was replaced with the same condition prefixed by `false &&` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 425bbac8 → 5dfe6457). The harness file then ran **4 failed | 12 passed (16)**: the four wrap pins (two formulas × two widths). The controls stayed green. Restore: blob == HEAD (425bbac8) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to `src/`, so no build sat between the mutation and the run.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs (head 91831e6d)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...'`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.relationUserFilters-13310.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNavigationMembers-8071.test.tsx packages/fields/src/__tests__/formulaFaces`: exit 0, **Test Files 399 passed | 1 skipped (400), Tests 3666 passed | 18 skipped**.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 38 commands): 38/38 exit 0. Reconciled with `--ran`.
- Narrowing: the record-page mounts were chosen by `git grep` of test files that import plugin-detail / DetailSection / RecordDetail and also name `formula` or `summary`. CI's Test UI shards run every package.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **`summary` (roll-up) text values still truncate on the record page.** `summary` maps to the same `FormulaCellRenderer`, and a roll-up holding a string reads through its one-line text face. It was not moved to `SummaryField`'s read display because that display draws a fixed `text-gray-700` with no dark-mode variant. Routing every roll-up through it would dim the common numeric roll-ups in dark mode on the record page. Measured in happy-dom on this branch's first head: a string summary rendered `span.text-sm.font-medium.tabular-nums.text-gray-700`. A text roll-up (`min`/`max` over a text child field) was not measured at a public door. Carrier: seat `domain:ui#1`. Dedupe words: summary field text-gray-700 dark mode; roll-up text value truncated record page.
- `FormulaField`'s number and date faces draw `span.text-sm` without the cell's `tabular-nums`. The digits are unchanged, and only their figure width changes on the record page. Polish only, not filed.

## Verification

CI check-runs on this PR are the record for the families CI runs; see the os-dev-report on the card.
